summary: Play Lichess games, challenge players, solve puzzles, or play offline.
release_notes: Offering the computer a draw no longer leaves the game menu open, a missed puzzle names its move as the board writes it and stays with that puzzle, and Pairing keeps the right time while a search is cancelled.

steps.text: Computer games and puzzles need no account. To play people, create a Lichess Personal Access Token granting only board:play.
On the reader, open Lichess, tap Your games, then Connect Lichess, and type the token.
Or install the token from a computer. Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Save the token in a private local file, then install it under the exact secret name lichess.

page_description: An unofficial Lichess client for Kobo. Play rated or casual games at rapid and classical time controls, accept or send challenges, solve puzzles, or play the computer offline, with or without a clock.
